rules.rationale: This is the base equation of the recursive derivAcc mathematical summary: processing an empty remaining coefficient sequence returns the accumulator. It defines the named proof term and does not rewrite an execution configuration.

This is the guarded nonpositive-index recurrence of derivAcc, consuming one sequence constructor while leaving the accumulator unchanged. It is a defining equation for the summary, including its simplification use, rather than an independently asserted mathematical fact.

This is the guarded positive-index recurrence of derivAcc, defining the next accumulator by appending the fixed-semantics multiplication term and recursing on the tail. Its left-hand side is the mathematical summary symbol, not a program control term, so the simplification rule is definitional.

This equation defines the empty-sequence base case of the total noRefsVS structural predicate. It introduces the meaning of a named input-domain helper and is not an additional theorem about an already defined symbol.

This equation recursively defines noRefsVS on a nonempty sequence using the supplied isRefV predicate and the tail. It is the structural step of the named predicate, not an operational observation or a separately trusted domain fact.
